gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with Wood Road between Victoria Technical College and Jockey Club Government School, running in a south-easterly direction for approximately 240 feet, thence in a southerly direction for approximately 90 feet and terminating at the southern boundary of I.L. 7616 as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. R.H. 1313.
